title: Chill

{{status | name = Chilled | type = Status Ailment | icon = Chill status icon.png | description = You are slowed }} [[File:Chill status ailment screenshot.jpg|thumb|A chilled Dune Hellion]] '''Chill''' is an elemental [[ailment]] inherent to [[cold]] that applies a slow effect to the character, reducing the animation speed at which the character plays. __TOC__ ==Mechanics== A [[hit]] of cold damage will attempt to inflict chill. This will occur regardless of whether or not the hit [[Critical strike|critically strikes]]. By default, only [[cold damage]] is able to inflict chill. Some skill effects and modifiers, such as [[Chilled ground]] and {{il|Summon Skitterbots}}, apply chill without dealing damage. The base duration of chill is 2 seconds and its effect is determined based on the the amount of Cold damage dealt relative to the enemy's ailment threshold. When inflicted through non-damage means, its base effect is 10%. Chill's effect is capped at 30% reduced [[action speed]]. The [[Elementalist]]'s {{psl|Shaper of Winter}} passive increases this up to 40%. Chill's minimum effect is 5%; any chill of lesser effect than that is discarded. The effect of chill is calculated using the following formula:https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Version_3.9.0 {{math|formula= E = 1/2 * ({D \over T})^{0.4} * ( 1 + M ) }} where D is the cold damage dealt, T is the enemy's ailment threshold, and M is the sum of the attacker's increases to the effect of chill (normally 0%). In the great majority of cases, a monster's ailment threshold is equal to its maximum life. It primarily differs for especially high-life monsters (such as [[The Shaper]]), where the threshold is reduced to allow [[ailment]]s to be applied with hits that wouldn't ordinarily reach the required life thresholds.https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Version_3.9.0 Chill is independent from [[freeze]]; a target that is frozen may not necessarily also be chilled. ===Example chill values=== {| class="wikitable" |- !Resulting
chill effect!!Percentage of enemy's
''ailment threshold'' dealt
as cold damage |- |5%||0.32% |- |10%||1.79% |- |15%||4.93% |- |20%||10.12% |- |25%||17.68% |- |30%||27.89% |- |35%||41% |- |40%||57.24% |} ===In-depth mechanics=== Some modifiers such as {{stl|Chilling Conflux}} or the modifier found on {{il|The Three Dragons}} can change which damage types are able to inflict chill. If the player is able to chill with multiple different damage types, the chill's effect is determined by the total damage dealt by all applicable damage types. Modifiers to chill effect, such as {{c|mod|X% increased Effect of Chill}}, apply to the effect of the chill ''before'' the minimum or maximum effect is enforced. This means that increases to the effect of chill effectively reduce the amount of damage needed to apply both a minimum and a maximum chill. For example, a total of {{c|mod|100% increased Effect of Chill}} would reduce the required amount of damage needed to apply a minimum effect chill to 0.06% of the enemy's ailment threshold, and reduce the required damage needed for a maximum chill to 4.93%. Unless otherwise specified, all sources of chill that apply without dealing damage have a base effect of 10% reduced [[action speed]] and scale with any modifiers to chill effectiveness.https://www.reddit.com/r/pathofexile/comments/9ahcnj/question_about_chillshock_on_block_scaling/e4y3dal/?context=3 Some sources of chill, which apply without dealing damage, are [[Chilling Ground]], {{il|Summon Skitterbots}}, and {{il|Wintertide Brand}}. The chill ailment is applied '''after''' the hit (not before), because the magnitude of the chill is based on damage dealt. ==Skill gems== {{main|List of chill related skill gems}} {{#lst:List of Please note there are passives that apply to [[ailment]]s or [[elemental status effect]]s in general are not listed here. ===Chill duration=== {{Query base passive skills |where= passive_skill_stats.id IN ("chill_duration_+%", "base_elemental_status_ailment_duration_+%", "cold_ailment_duration_+%") }} ===Chill effect=== {{Query base passive skills |where= passive_skill_stats.id IN ("chill_effect_+%", "non_damaging_ailment_effect_+%") }} ===Chance to avoid being Chilled=== {{Query base passive skills |where= passive_skill_stats.id = "base_avoid_chill_%" }} ===Miscellaneous=== '''Passives''' related to chill include: {{Query base passive skills |where= passive_skill_stats.id LIKE "%chill%" AND passive_skill_stats.id NOT IN ("chill_duration_+%", "chill_effect_+%", "base_avoid_chill_%") }} ===Cluster jewel passives=== The following [[cluster jewel]]-only passives are related to chill: {{Passive skill table |q_where= passive_skills.id LIKE "affliction%" AND passive_skills.stat_text LIKE "%chill%" |large=1 |stat_text=1 }} ===Ascendancy passives=== {{Query ascendancy passive skills |where= passive_skill_stats.id LIKE "%chill%" OR passive_skill_stats.id LIKE "%desolation%" }} ===Masteries=== {{Query masteries}} ===Tattoos=== {{Drop enabled item table |tables = tattoos |join = items._pageID = tattoos._pageID |where = items.class_id="StackableCurrency" AND tattoos.target IS NOT NULL AND items.description LIKE "%chill%" |large=1 |description=1 }} ==Pantheon== {{Pantheon|q_where=pantheon.id="TheBrineKing"}} ==Version history== {{Version history table header}} {{Version history table row|3.21.1| * Elemental Ailments other than Freeze are no longer discarded if their duration is lower than 300ms. }} {{Version history table row|3.9.0| * [[Shock]] and Chill calculations have been changed. In general, it is much easier to Shock and Chill monsters with low values of the ailment, but harder to reach high values of Shock and Chill. The formula used to calculate Shock and Chill magnitudes is now: 1/2*[Damage % of Ailment Threshold (see below) ]^0.4 * We've added an Ailment Threshold to monsters. In the great majority of cases, the Ailment Threshold matches the monster's Maximum Life. It primarily differs for especially high-life monsters (such as The Shaper), where the threshold is reduced to allow [[ailment]]s to be applied with hits that wouldn't ordinarily reach the required Life thresholds. * The minimum Shock and Chill value is now 5% (from 1%). To reach the minimum, you must deal 0.4% of a monster's Ailment Threshold with the associated element in a single hit. To inflict a 10% Chill you must deal 1.8% of a monster's Ailment Threshold with the associated element in a single hit. A 30% Chill requires a hit of 28% of the monster's Ailment Threshold. }} {{Version history table row|3.0.0| * Chill no longer slows enemies by a fixed amount for a variable duration. Now, Chill will slow enemies for a duration of 2 seconds by an amount based on the Cold damage dealt to the enemy. A purely Cold hit which removes 10% of an enemy's life will slow that enemy by 30% for 2 seconds, scaling linearly down to 0% at no Cold damage dealt. * Increased Effect of Chill and Increased Effect of Shock will increase the amount that each ailment affects whatever they are afflicting, up to their respective caps. * Chilled ground has a fixed slowing effect of 10%. * Other non-hit sources of Chill, unless otherwise specified in the debuff, will slow by 10%. }} {{Version history table row|2.0.2| * {{il|Temporal Chains}}' slowing effect now applies multiplicatively with Chill's slowing effect. This will result in less of an impact when both are used on the same target. }} {{Version history table row|0.10.0| * The "Chilled" statuses from cold damage and [[Chilled Ground|ground ice]] do not stack any more. }} {{Version history table row|0.8.6| * New effects for chilled. }} {{Version history table row|0.7.0| * Improved calculation of the chilled effect. }} {{Version history table row|0.6.12| * Improved chilled effect. }} {{Version history table row|0.6.11| * Added a new status ailment: chilled. }} {{Version history table end}} ==References== {{reflist|refs= {{cite web|author=Mark_GGG|date=November 18, 2015|title=Item Development - Threshold Jewels|url=https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/1480913/page/5#p12067930|publisher=Official Path of Exile Forums|accessdate=November 18, 2015}} {{cite web|author=Mark_GGG|date=November 24, 2015|title=Unstoppable question|url=https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/1483085/page/3#p12099090|publisher=Official Path of Exile Forums|accessdate=February 9, 2016}} {{cite web|author=Malice|date=November 13, 2011|title=Mechanics thread|url=http://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/11707#p216023|publisher=Official Path of Exile Forums|accessdate=July 5, 2013}} {{cite web|author=Mark_GGG|date=September 4, 2014|title=Does shock bonus apply to first hit?|url=https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/1037777/page/1#p8702629|publisher=Official Path of Exile Forums|accessdate=May 21, 2016}} {{cite web|author=Mark_GGG|date=March 15, 2020|title=Cold Conduction Cluster Jewel Notable Clarification|url=https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/2789151#p22967191|publisher=Official Path of Exile Forums|accessdate=February 12, 2022}} }} [[Category:Ailments]]
